ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Name the part of the animal cell involved in ribosomal RNA synthesis?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached animal cell diagram labels several organelles, including the nucleus and a smaller structure inside it labeled 'Nucleolus.' Reasoning: The question asks which animal cell part is involved in ribosomal RNA synthesis. In cell biology, ribosomal RNA is synthesized in the nucleolus, where ribosome subunit assembly begins. Therefore, the part is the nucleolus.
